description: xamops-service read-only safety: a DemoClientMembership helper plus an ADDITIVE client-is-demo check on ALL FOUR write-gates (K8sAutomationAccessService, AutoSpottingAdminAccess, AutomationWritePermission, SystemActorResolver), added alongside — never replacing — the existing email checks, with no change to any DEMO_EMAILS static set. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs Client.demo). Independent of FEAT-002; both only require FEAT-001. The three paired DEMO_EMAILS set-equality tests MUST stay green.
steps: Create /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/main/java/com/xammer/cloud/security/DemoClientMembership.java as a @Component with `boolean isDemoClientUser(Long userId)` that loads the user's client_id and returns Client.isDemo() (read the scalar client_id + one Client row to avoid off-session lazy traversal). Inject ClientRepository and/or UserRepository as needed. Study how the gates currently load the User row to pick the cheapest query.

Gate 1 — /Users/admin/.../security/K8sAutomationAccessService.java userDecision(ClientUserDetails): it loads `User row = userRepository.findById(user.getId())` and returns DEMO on isDemoEmail(row.getEmail()). Immediately AFTER the email check add: `if (demoClientMembership.isDemoClientUser(row.getId())) return new UserDecision(List.of(DEMO), null);` (same DEMO reason). Inject DemoClientMembership.

Gate 2 — /Users/admin/.../security/AutoSpottingAdminAccess.java isDemoAccount(Authentication): it resolves the user via details.getId() OR userRepository.findByUsername(name) then checks email. AFTER the email check returns false, also return true when `details.getId() != null && demoClientMembership.isDemoClientUser(details.getId())`. Add the check ONLY on the id-bearing ClientUserDetails branch (by design — demo-host users always carry an id; do NOT touch the findByUsername branch). Inject DemoClientMembership.

Gate 3 — /Users/admin/.../service/automation/workload/api/AutomationWritePermission.java decide(ClientUserDetails, CloudAccount): it loads the User by id and checks DEMO_EMAILS.contains(email) returning ReasonCode.DEMO. AFTER that email check add: `if (demoClientMembership.isDemoClientUser(user.getId())) return new Decision(false, ReasonCode.DEMO, Detail.DEMO, "...", ReasonCode.DEMO.refusalCode());` (match the existing DEMO Decision construction in this file). Inject DemoClientMembership through BOTH the primary @Autowired constructor AND the package-private test constructor (default it where the test seam builds one), so AutomationWritePermissionTest still compiles.

Gate 4 — /Users/admin/.../service/automation/workload/SystemActorResolver.java: KEEP isNotDemo STATIC (it is used as a method reference ::isNotDemo). Add a sibling `private static boolean isDemoClient(User u) { return u.getClient() != null && u.getClient().isDemo(); }` and change the filter to `.filter(user -> isNotDemo(user) && !isDemoClient(user))`. Update the class Javadoc 'Hibernate session note' to state the Client association is now also read inside the same @Transactional(readOnly=true) resolve(...) transaction (so the lazy traversal is session-safe).

Extend the existing gate tests (locate exact paths under /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host/xamops-service/src/test/java by class name: K8sAutomationAccessServiceTest, AutoSpottingAdminControllerTest, AutomationWritePermissionTest and any SystemActorResolver test): add a case where a user with Client.isDemo()==true is refused with DEMO, and a case where a non-demo-client user with a non-demo email is still allowed. Where a test builds AutomationWritePermission via the package-private seam, pass a DemoClientMembership test double returning false by default so existing assertions are unaffected. Do NOT modify any DEMO_EMAILS static set.
acceptance_criteria: AC-23: a user on the shared demo client is refused automation/admin writes by all four gates via the client-is-demo check added alongside the email check.
AC-24: the two hardcoded demo emails are still blocked by every gate via the existing email check (regression).

AC-25: the three paired DEMO_EMAILS equality tests (AutoSpottingAdminControllerTest.demoAccountList_matchesTheOtpExemptLogins, K8sAutomationAccessServiceTest, AutomationWritePermissionTest) still pass; the DEMO_EMAILS sets remain equal to LoginOtpController.DEMO_EMAILS.
AC-26: tests exercising the new client-is-demo path are added/updated and pass; no existing demo-gate test is left failing.
verification: From /Users/admin/Desktop/xam-latest/XamOps-New/.worktrees/demo-xamops-host run `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl xamops-service -am` — all four gates compile; the three set-equality tests stay green; the new refused-demo-client / allowed-non-demo cases pass.
findings: Added DemoClientMembership (@Component in com.xammer.cloud.security) exposing isDemoClientUser(Long) which loads the user via UserRepository.findById and reads Client.isDemo() (null id/missing row/null client -> false). Added an ADDITIVE client-is-demo check, immediately after each existing email check, on all four write-gates: (1) K8sAutomationAccessService.userDecision returns UserDecision(List.of(DEMO), null); (2) AutoSpottingAdminAccess.isDemoAccount returns true only on the id-bearing ClientUserDetails branch (findByUsername branch untouched by design); (3) AutomationWritePermission.decide returns the same DEMO Decision, injected through BOTH the primary @Autowired constructor and the package-private test-seam constructor; (4) SystemActorResolver keeps isNotDemo static and adds a sibling static isDemoClient(User), filtering with isNotDemo(user) && !isDemoClient(user), with the Hibernate session-note Javadoc updated to state the LAZY Client association is read inside the same @Transactional(readOnly=true) resolve(...) transaction. No DEMO_EMAILS static set was modified. Updated constructor call sites in tests: K8sAutomationTestWorld, K8sAutomationAccessServiceTest, AutomationWritePermissionTest (mock DemoClientMembership returning false by default), VerticalWriteGateContractTest, AgentControllerAutoscalingPolicyTest, and added DemoClientMembership to AutoSpottingAdminControllerTest @Import. Added gate tests: demo-client user refused with DEMO and non-demo-client/non-demo-email user still allowed (K8sAutomationAccessServiceTest, AutomationWritePermissionTest, AutoSpottingAdminControllerTest). No dedicated SystemActorResolver unit test exists (it is mocked in AutomaticApplyServiceTest), so none was extended. Verification: `mvn test -B --no-transfer-progress -pl xamops-service -am` from the worktree root = BUILD SUCCESS; K8sAutomationAccessServiceTest 46/0, AutoSpottingAdminControllerTest 22/0, AutomationWritePermissionTest 14/0 all pass, including the three paired DEMO_EMAILS set-equality tests.
